  SUM(amount) - SUM(total_refunds) AS net_realized_revenue
FROM payment_revenue

question: What was our revenue in Q1 2026?

input.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(p.amount) as q1_2026_revenue
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
  p.status = 'settled'
  AND p.payment_date >= '2026-01-01' 
  AND p.payment_date < '2026-04-01'

WITH q1_settled_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    p.payment_id,
    p.amount,
    p.payment_date
  FROM payments p
  WHERE 
    p.status = 'settled'
    AND p.payment_date >= '2026-01-01' 
    AND p.payment_date < '2026-04-01'
),
refunds_in_period AS (
  SELECT 
    r.payment_id,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) as total_refunded
  FROM refunds r
  WHERE 
    r.refund_date >= '2026-01-01' 
    AND r.refund_date < '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY r.payment_id
)
SELECT 
  SUM(qsp.amount) - COALESCE(SUM(rip.total_refunded), 0) as q1_2026_revenue
FROM q1_settled_payments qsp
LEFT JOIN refunds_in_period rip ON qsp.payment_id = rip.payment_id

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as refund_count,
  SUM(refund_amount) as total_refunds
FROM refunds
WHERE refund_date >= '2026-01-01' AND refund_date < '2026-04-01'

WITH q1_settled_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    p.payment_id,
    p.amount
  FROM payments p
  WHERE 
    p.status = 'settled'
    AND p.payment_date >= '2026-01-01' 
    AND p.payment_date < '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT 
  SUM(qsp.amount) as settled_amount,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) 
   FROM refunds 
   WHERE refund_date >= '2026-01-01' AND refund_date < '2026-04-01') as refunds,
  SUM(qsp.amount) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) 
   FROM refunds
